registration: Register the boiler within 30 days of installation, online or through your installer.
conditions: The boiler was installed and commissioned by a suitably qualified, registered engineer.
The warranty was registered within 30 days of installation.
The boiler has been serviced every 12 months by a registered engineer, and the service log is up to date.
The heating system was cleaned and protected with inhibitor when the boiler was installed.
Only genuine Norvane parts have been fitted.
covered: Parts and labour to repair a manufacturing fault in the boiler.
Replacement of the boiler if it cannot be repaired.
The primary heat exchanger for the full warranty period.
notCovered: Faults caused by the wider heating system, such as sludge, scale or leaking radiators.
Frozen condensate pipes and other weather damage.
Faults caused by the gas, water or electricity supply.
Third-party controls, and consumable items replaced at a routine service.
Boilers that have missed an annual service.
extendedWarranty: Boilers fitted by a Norvane Approved Installer receive 2 extra years on top of the standard warranty.
howToClaim: Call the Norvane warranty line on 0808 157 0146 with your serial number and service log to hand. Lines are open 8am to 6pm, Monday to Saturday.
